name: claim_gate_manager_show
xsql:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_valid,
       Concat('Reviewing ',
              Concat(FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(1), 0), '#,##0'),
                     ' direct report(s)')) AS scope_label
FROM   xactly.xc_pos_hierarchy ph
WHERE  ph.from_pos_id  = :v_master_position_id
  AND  ph.to_pos_id   <> :v_master_position_id
  AND  ph.is_active    = 1
